react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Too many screens defined. Route "violations" is extraneous.' — a Stack.Screen for 'violations' is declared in the layout but no route file exists (or vice versa). Non-blocking but should be cleaned. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx (or /(tabs)/_layout.tsx)
Benign warning: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web'. Expected on web preview only. Reference: /app/frontend/src/notifications.ts
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — leaks from expo-router/RN internals; non-blocking.

action_items: (Minor) Clean the extraneous 'violations' Stack.Screen entry from the tabs/root layout to remove the 'Too many screens defined' warning.

critical_code_review_comments: Solid: phone normalization to 966E164, temp password randomization, JWT auth flow, must_change_password gating.
Solid: leaves conflict logic checks same location_id + same group + status=approved + date overlap, ignores group='none', correctly excludes self.
Solid: fuel model no longer contains liters field — verified in schema and roundtrip response.
Solid: schedule 8-day cycle anchored at 2026-07-16 wraps correctly (verified 3 dates + full 14-day sweep).
Solid: 5 real Makkah locations auto-seed only on admin-setup and startup guard prevents demo data leaks.
Solid: /violations/{id}/notify-info marks notified=true (idempotent), returns 400 if employee has no phone.
Solid: admin-only require_admin dep guards all mutating endpoints uniformly with arabic detail 'هذه العملية مسموحة للمدير فقط'.
Minor: server.py still uses @app.on_event('startup'|'shutdown') — deprecated in FastAPI ≥0.100 (use lifespan). Same as previous iteration.
Minor: /auth/register when zero users returns 400 'يجب إعداد حساب المدير أولاً' — good UX but could redirect FE to setup automatically (already handled via /auth/status).
